payload.notes: Only official government helplines are listed. Bank card-block numbers are deliberately empty: they are added by the user in the app and shown as unverified. Every entry must be checked against its sourceUrl before a release; entries with needsVerification=true must not ship unchecked.

helplines.name: National Cyber Crime Helpline
helplines.purpose: Lost money to online or UPI fraud? Call immediately: reporting within the first hours gives the best chance of freezing the money.

helplines.name: National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal
helplines.purpose: File a complaint about financial fraud or any other cyber crime online, and track it.

helplines.name: Chakshu (Sanchar Saathi)
helplines.purpose: Report suspected fraud calls, SMS or WhatsApp messages (fake KYC, impersonation, fake customer care) to the Department of Telecommunications.
helplines.verificationNote: Confirm the Chakshu deep link (/sfc/) still opens the suspected-fraud-communication form.

helplines.name: TRAI spam complaint (1909)
helplines.purpose: Report unsolicited commercial SMS (spam) to your operator under TRAI's rules. Send the message text, the sender and the date.
helplines.verificationNote: Confirm the complaint SMS format (message text, sender, dd/mm/yy separated by commas) and the complaint window (3 days in TCCCPR 2018; reportedly extended by a 2025 amendment) on TRAI's consumer page.

helplines.name: TRAI DND and spam complaints (call 1909)
helplines.purpose: Call your operator's 1909 line to register a spam complaint or change your Do Not Disturb preferences.

helplines.name: Emergency (112)
helplines.purpose: Police, fire, ambulance: India's single emergency number.

helplines.name: RBI Complaint Management System
helplines.purpose: Complain to the RBI Ombudsman when your bank, card issuer or payment app hasn't resolved your complaint.

helplines.name: RBI Contact Centre (14448)
helplines.purpose: Help with filing a complaint against a bank or payment company with the RBI.
helplines.verificationNote: Confirm 14448 is still the RBI Contact Centre toll-free number (and its hours) on cms.rbi.org.in.

helplines.name: RBI Sachet
helplines.purpose: Report companies illegally collecting deposits or running unregulated investment schemes.
